verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents Playgrounds as a no-code workspace for iterating on prompts across models, scorers, and datasets, with real-time evaluations and side-by-side comparison. That covers the core of the story. However, the evidence never explicitly describes prompt template variables or how they are bound to dataset inputs, and nothing independent corroborates playground use. missing for 10: explicit documentation of prompt variables/templating in the playground, independent or hands-on corroboration of playground iteration against live models.

support.subject: As a developer, I can iterate on prompts in a playground against real models and variables

citations.quote: Playgrounds provide a no-code workspace for rapidly iterating on prompts, models, scorers, and datasets.
Run full evaluations in real-time, compare results side-by-side, and share configurations with teammates.
Measure and improve AI application quality with playgrounds and evals
